description: Mutation cases for the output schemas. Each case takes a valid base document, applies its ops, and names what must happen to the result. Paths are relative to skills/. Nothing here is placed in a skill bundle.
ops: Each op has a JSON Pointer path. set replaces the value at the path, or adds the member when it is absent. remove deletes it; removing an array item shifts the later ones.
placeholders: Forty zeros and forty ones stand for baseSha and headSha, and sixty-four zeros for specSetSha256 and planSha256, as in _shared/evals.md.

inline.summary: The due column now sorts by date in both directions with undated tasks last, and each criterion has a test that fails without the fix.
